propositions: Eight empty, uncommitted stray directories in the tickets tracker are flagged as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH by fsck, all confirmed to be debris from interrupted writes with no active file handles and mtimes outside the live-writer window.

The rebar tracker-maintenance --clean command deletes all foreign paths returned by --status in an all-or-nothing operation, so the run-level guard requires the foreign list to be byte-equal to exactly the eight triaged ids before proceeding.
All eight directories pass five per-directory guards: empty, uncommitted, rebar exists exits 1, zero open handles, and mtime older than 30 minutes, qualifying them for safe removal.

After executing tracker-maintenance --clean with the equality gate holding, all eight directories are removed, fsck no longer reports MISSING_CREATE or FOREIGN_STORE_PATH findings, and no committed tracker data is modified.
